abstract: The main findings of the comparison are as follows. Overall, Brostamide and Standard care reach about the same side effects. Overall, Cardivel and Standard care reach about the same side effects.
conclusion: Taken together, the arms compare as follows. Overall, Brostamide and Standard care reach about the same side effects. Overall, Cardivel and Standard care reach about the same side effects.
section:
### A further comparison between arms

Standard care is the usual blood pressure treatment given to every patient. Brostamide is a water tablet that helps the body clear extra salt. Cardivel is a tablet that slows the heart so it pushes with less force. This comparison was run at the Riverside Pressure Registry.

Table 2. Results for each arm and measure, split by subset.

| Subset | Arm | Measure | Count | Total |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Younger adults, Normal kidney function, University hospital | Standard care | Side effects | 136 | 600 |
| Younger adults, Normal kidney function, University hospital | Brostamide | Side effects | 137 | 600 |
| Younger adults, Normal kidney function, University hospital | Cardivel | Side effects | 119 | 600 |
| Older adults, Normal kidney function, University hospital | Standard care | Side effects | 131 | 600 |
| Older adults, Normal kidney function, University hospital | Brostamide | Side effects | 144 | 600 |
| Older adults, Normal kidney function, University hospital | Cardivel | Side effects | 158 | 600 |

These values are listed for every arm and every subset.
